_: The story's clock, in seconds (an Instagram Story: film.md → Stories). Story.tsx animates from these beats and `film.mjs sfx <slug>` puts each beat's `sound` on it in audio/sfx-cues.json, so moving a beat moves both. A `text` beat rises over 0.3 s: every one starts by 0.7 s, so all the words are on screen within the first second. After 1 s only a `decor` beat moves (the highlighter sweep). Two or three sounds at most, no music, no voice: one sound for the whole burst of words, never one per line. A sound from the library is `<group>/<name>`; `fallback` is the kit sound used while the library has no take of it.
